chunks: And Abū Baṣīr narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who forgot to wipe his head, he said: “Then let him wipe.”
He said: He did not remember it until he entered into the salat (prayer). He said: “Then let him wipe his head with the moisture of his beard.”

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the salat (prayer) into which he had already entered
key_terms.رَأْسِهِ: his head, the body part to be wiped in wudu (ablution)
key_terms.لِحْيَتِهِ: his beard, whose moisture is used for the wiping
key_terms.مَسْحَ: wiping as a required act in wudu (ablution)

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgot to wipe his head in wudu (ablution) and only remembered during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgets to wipe the head in wudu (ablution). If he remembers later, even after entering the salat (prayer), he should wipe his head using the remaining moisture from his beard.
